houses.name: The Grey Rhino
houses.line: Slow feet, sealed letters. Nobody reads what we write.

houses.name: River Watch
houses.line: Hold the fords, trust no rider, and let the mist hide our strength until the final watch.

houses.name: Orchid's Thorn Commander
houses.line: We bloom where others break — hold the fords, guard the valley, let no rider pass unseen.

houses.name: Old Stripe
houses.line: Two riders, two roads. One always gets through.
